entries.subject: a Book

spans.text: [2] AR: كِتَٰبٌ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ فَلَا يَكُن فِى صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌۭ مِّنْهُ لِتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ EN: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muhammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers.

spans.text: [3] AR: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۗ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ EN: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies.

spans.text: [4] AR: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَٰتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُونَ EN: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

spans.text: [6] AR: فَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ EN: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.
[7] AR: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِم بِعِلْمٍۢ ۖ وَمَا كُنَّا غَآئِبِينَ EN: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.

spans.text: [9] AR: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَظْلِمُونَ EN: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.

spans.text: [10] AR: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ ۗ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ EN: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood.

[11] AR: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ ثُمَّ صَوَّرْنَٰكُمْ ثُمَّ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ لَمْ يَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ EN: And We have certainly created you, [O Mankind], and given you [human] form.

[23] AR: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ EN: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

spans.text: [6] AR: فَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ EN: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.

folded.id: and you|will|not find most of them grateful [to you]
folded.subject: and You
folded.object: not find most of them grateful [to You]

spans.text: [17] AR: ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمْ ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَٰكِرِينَ EN: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]."

[19] AR: وَيَٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ فَكُلَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

folded.id: because you|have|put me in error
folded.subject: Because You
folded.object: put me in error

spans.text: [16] AR: قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ EN: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path.

folded.id: but satan|whispered|to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts
folded.subject: But Satan
folded.object: to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts

spans.text: [20] AR: فَوَسْوَسَ لَهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِيُبْدِىَ لَهُمَا مَا وُۥرِىَ عَنْهُمَا مِن سَوْءَٰتِهِمَا وَقَالَ مَا نَهَىٰكُمَا رَبُّكُمَا عَنْ هَٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَا مَلَكَيْنِ أَوْ تَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْخَٰلِدِينَ EN: But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts.

folded.id: for it|is|not for you to be arrogant therein
folded.subject: for it
folded.object: not for you to be arrogant therein

spans.text: [13] AR: قَالَ فَٱهْبِطْ مِنْهَا فَمَا يَكُونُ لَكَ أَن تَتَكَبَّرَ فِيهَا فَٱخْرُجْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰغِرِينَ EN: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise, for it is not for you to be arrogant therein.

folded.id: i|will|surely fill hell with you
folded.subject: I
folded.object: surely fill Hell with you

spans.text: Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together."

folded.id: i|will|surely sit in wait for them on your straight path
folded.subject: I
folded.object: surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path

spans.text: [16] AR: قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ EN: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path.

folded.id: it you|will|be brought forth
folded.subject: it you
folded.object: be brought forth

spans.text: [25] AR: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ EN: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."

folded.id: it|is|they who will be the successful
folded.subject: it
folded.object: they who will be the successful

spans.text: So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.

folded.id: many cities|have|we destroyed
folded.subject: many cities
folded.object: We destroyed

spans.text: [4] AR: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَٰتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُونَ EN: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

folded.id: not satan|tempt|you as he removed your parents from paradise
folded.subject: not Satan
folded.object: you as he removed your parents from Paradise

spans.text: [27] AR: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ كَمَآ أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَنزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتِهِمَآ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ يَرَىٰكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُۥ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing to show them their private parts.

folded.id: ones who|will|lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward our verses
folded.subject: ones who
folded.object: lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses

spans.text: [9] AR: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَظْلِمُونَ EN: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.

folded.id: that day|will|be the truth
folded.subject: that Day
folded.object: be the truth

spans.text: [8] AR: وَٱلْوَزْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ EN: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth.

folded.id: that satan|is|to you a clear enemy?"
folded.subject: that Satan
folded.object: to you a clear enemy?"

spans.text: And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"

folded.id: that|is|best
folded.subject: that
folded.object: best

spans.text: But the clothing of righteousness - that is best.

folded.id: that|is|from the signs of allah that perhaps they will remember
folded.subject: That
folded.object: from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember

spans.text: That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember.

folded.id: the earth|is|a place of settlement and enjoyment for a time
folded.subject: the earth
folded.object: a place of settlement and enjoyment for a time

spans.text: And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment for a time."

folded.id: their lord|called|to them
folded.subject: their Lord
folded.object: to them

spans.text: And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"

folded.id: then i|will|come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left
folded.subject: Then I
folded.object: come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left

spans.text: [17] AR: ثُمَّ لَءَاتِيَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ وَعَنْ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ وَعَن شَمَآئِلِهِمْ ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ أَكْثَرَهُمْ شَٰكِرِينَ EN: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]."

folded.id: then we|will|surely question those to whom [a message] was sent
folded.subject: Then We
folded.object: surely question those to whom [a message] was sent

spans.text: [6] AR: فَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَنَسْـَٔلَنَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ EN: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.
[7] AR: فَلَنَقُصَّنَّ عَلَيْهِم بِعِلْمٍۢ ۖ وَمَا كُنَّا غَآئِبِينَ EN: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.

folded.id: therein you|will|die
folded.subject: therein you
folded.object: die

spans.text: [25] AR: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ EN: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."

folded.id: therein you|will|live
folded.subject: Therein you
folded.object: live

spans.text: [25] AR: قَالَ فِيهَا تَحْيَوْنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنْهَا تُخْرَجُونَ EN: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."

folded.id: we|have|bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment
folded.subject: We
folded.object: bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment

spans.text: [26] AR: يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ قَدْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًۭا يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَٰتِكُمْ وَرِيشًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ EN: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment.

folded.id: we|have|made the devils allies to those who do not believe
folded.subject: We
folded.object: made the devils allies to those who do not believe

spans.text: Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe.

folded.id: we|have|wronged ourselves
folded.subject: we
folded.object: wronged ourselves

spans.text: [23] AR: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ EN: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

folded.id: we|will|surely be among the losers
folded.subject: we
folded.object: surely be among the losers

spans.text: [23] AR: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ EN: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

folded.id: what|has|been revealed to you from your lord and do not follow other than him any allies
folded.subject: what
folded.object: been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies

spans.text: [3] AR: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۗ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ EN: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies.

folded.id: your lord|did|not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal
folded.subject: Your Lord
folded.object: not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal

spans.text: He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal."
